title: Alginate- and κ-carrageenan-supported asymmetric organocatalysts: preparation, characterization, and catalytic activity for Friedel–Crafts alkylation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30865-30871
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05785J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Manaho Murakishi, Shogo Nakanishi, Hiromitsu Sogawa, Fumio Sanda
Alginate- and κ-carrageenan-supported imidazolidinone catalysts were newly prepared, and their catalytic activities for the Friedel–Crafts alkylation of 1-methylindole with crotonaldehyde were evaluated.
